_readme: Edit names here. Teams: code (do not change), name, short (2-4 letters), city, stadium, colors [main, second], rating (or ratings [attack, midfield, defense]). On the next start the game applies name, short name, city, stadium and colours to every save — except teams you changed in the in-game editor.

teams.name: Green Vila do Conde
teams.stadium: Estadio Municipal de Vila do Conde

cards.name: Pass
cards.description: You keep the ball. Three passes in a row = Big Chance.

cards.name: Corner
cards.description: Corner kick: pick near post, far post or a short corner.

cards.name: Free Kick
cards.description: Free kick: shoot, cross or play it short.

cards.name: Tackle
cards.description: Ball lost — the other team flips.

cards.name: Offside
cards.description: Flag up — the other team flips.

cards.name: Save
cards.description: The keeper saves — the other team flips.

cards.name: Miss
cards.description: Wide! The other team flips.

cards.name: Yellow Card
cards.description: Booked. A second yellow is a red. The other team flips.

cards.name: Red Card
cards.description: Sent off: lose a hand card, no more Big Chances from passes.

cards.name: Goal!
cards.description: Goal for the team that flips it.

cards.name: Penalty
cards.description: Penalty: pick a side and time your shot.

cards.name: Half Time
cards.description: Only in the first-half grid. The grid is reshuffled for the second half.

cards.name: Full Time
cards.description: Only in the second-half grid. The final whistle.

cards.name: Striker
cards.description: Clean through on goal — 35% goal for whoever flips it (the opponent can steal it).

cards.name: Big Chance
cards.description: A Big Chance shot for whoever flips it (the opponent can steal it).

cards.name: Long Shot
cards.description: 12% goal; if it misses the flipper keeps the ball (the opponent can steal it).

cards.name: Playmaker
cards.description: A free Scout and the flipper keeps the ball (the opponent can steal it).

cards.name: Captain
cards.description: The flipper's next Tackle is ignored (the opponent can steal it).

cards.name: Wall
cards.description: The next goal against the flipper this half becomes a Save (the opponent can steal it).

cards.name: Offside Trap
cards.description: Owner: works like a Pass. Cannot be stolen — an opponent who flips it is caught offside and loses the ball.

cards.name: Counter Attack
cards.description: Flip 2 more cards — dangerous ones don't count (the opponent can steal it).

cards.name: Squad Player
cards.description: Free filler: works like a Pass for whoever flips it.

cards.name: Winger
cards.description: Whoever flips it gets a corner (mini-game) — and keeps the ball even if it does not end in a goal.

cards.name: Goalkeeper
cards.description: The next shot or penalty against whoever flips it is 20% less likely to go in.

cards.name: Target Man
cards.description: The next cross (corner or free kick) of whoever flips it is 20% more likely to go in.

cards.name: Sweeper
cards.description: The next Offside or Save of whoever flips it is ignored — they keep the ball.

cards.name: Super Sub
cards.description: 2nd half: 60% goal for whoever flips it. 1st half: works like a Pass.

cards.name: Decoy
cards.description: Owner: works like a Pass. Cannot be stolen — an opponent who flips it gains nothing and loses their pass streak.

cards.name: 12th Man
cards.description: For the home team: the next dangerous card is ignored. For the away team: works like a Pass.

cards.name: Scout
cards.description: Look under one face-down card.

cards.name: Swap
cards.description: Swap the places of two face-down cards.

cards.name: Calm
cards.description: If your next card is a Tackle, you keep the ball.

cards.name: Press
cards.description: When you next lose the ball, flip one more card straight away.

cards.name: Burn
cards.description: Blind: burns a random face-down team card of the opponent. You don't see which.

cards.name: VAR
cards.description: The opponent's next goal is checked: 40% chance it is disallowed.

cards.name: Marking
cards.description: Pick one of your face-down cards: if the opponent flips it, they can't steal it and lose the ball.

cards.name: Substitution
cards.description: Pick one of your team cards that is already face up: it goes back face down to a random place.

cards.name: Analysis
cards.description: Pick a row: you learn how many of the opponent's cards are hidden in it.

cards.name: Penalty Taker
cards.description: Your next penalty is 10% more likely to go in.

cards.name: +1 Goal
cards.description: 1 Pass in the grid becomes a Goal.

cards.name: +2 Goal
cards.description: 2 Pass cards become Goals.

cards.name: -1 Goal
cards.description: 1 Goal in the grid becomes a Pass.

cards.name: -2 Goal
cards.description: 2 Goals become Pass cards.

cards.name: +1 Corner
cards.description: 1 Pass becomes a Corner.

cards.name: +2 Corner
cards.description: 2 Pass cards become Corners.

cards.name: -1 Corner
cards.description: 1 Corner becomes a Pass.

cards.name: -2 Corner
cards.description: 2 Corners become Pass cards.

cards.name: +1 Tackle
cards.description: 1 Pass becomes a Tackle — a harder game for both.

cards.name: +1 Penalty
cards.description: 1 Pass becomes a Penalty.

cards.name: +1 Free Kick
cards.description: 1 Pass becomes a Free Kick.

cards.name: -1 Tackle
cards.description: 1 Tackle becomes a Pass.

cards.name: +1 Save
cards.description: 1 Pass becomes a Save.

cards.name: Wet pitch
cards.description: 1 Pass becomes a Miss.
